gruss_morgen.text: ... good morning ... the dew told stories last night ... I listened in for you ...

gruss_tag.text: ... I am Luna ... speak softly ... the wild horses up there are counting our words ...

gruss_abend.text: ... lovely that you come when the light turns soft ... at this hour all hearts are tamer ...

gruss_regen.text: ... do you hear the rain? ... it is applause for everyone who goes outside anyway ... it means you ...

gruss_freund.text: ... you ... the wild horses have given you a name ... The-one-with-the-good-step ... they almost never do that ...

text: ... the lead mare snorted three times today ... that means: a good hay year ...
... or hay fever ... my Wild Horsish still has gaps ...
... the herd talks about you ... only good things ... and once, something about your hair ...
... horses do not understand hairstyles ... they have manes ... opinions grow right in ...
... I told the wild horses about you ... they listened without running away ...
... do you know what that means? ... for wild horses, standing still is a declaration of love ...

quest_vergabe.text: ... yes ... there is something ... the hills have asked for it ... they rarely ask ...

quest_annahme.text: ... good ... walk with a soft step ... and if something large snorts at you ... simply breathe back ...

ablehnung.text: ... the wind understands ... he postpones everything constantly too ... mostly leaves ...

quest_abgabe.text: ... I know ... the hills already told me ... they are terribly fast with news ... here, your thanks ...

geschenk_liebt.text: ... a flower ... you picked it without startling the meadow ... I can feel that ... thank you ...

geschenk_mag.text: ... how kind ... I will share it with the wind ... the wind only takes the scent though ...

geschenk_normal.text: ... oh ... it is very ... loud, this gift ... but it means well ... like you ...

text: ... why I whisper? ... as a child, I shouted once ... once ...
... a whole herd of wild horses ran for three days ... they still send me the bill ...
... I have whispered ever since ... the world listens better when you do not yell at it ...
... Cling-Clang ... the old wild horse with the forged hoof ... Ironhoof's masterpiece ...
... it leads the herd across the hills ... you hear it before you see it ... cling, clang ...
... one day I will introduce you ... once your step gets a little softer ... we will practice ...

tschuess.text: ... go gently ... and leave the door open in the wind ... he likes to come in with you ...
